verdict.rationale: Firstbase's registered-agent service page states that it tracks compliance requirements and deadlines and will "file all annual reports and franchise tax reports on your behalf." That service is offered as a priced plan ($299 per state/year), and a compliance dashboard surfaces upcoming deadlines and actions. The community notes on Wyoming annual report obligations describe the requirement itself and do not contradict Firstbase's filing service. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the filing workflow and whether state filing fees are included in the plan price, and independent or hands-on confirmation that Firstbase actually files annual reports.
